decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of an established anamnesis app that already survived its first year, it remains a niche but strategically fitting option worth keeping open.

Because this service builds on the firm's support strengths and can deepen customer retention, management would likely continue it, though its labor intensity makes it more droppable than a software module.
As a newly launched module close to the core software, it is still in the option-testing phase and is likely cheap enough to keep while demand becomes clearer.

Secure healthcare messaging is closely tied to regulation and digital integration in dental practices, so the firm would likely keep this strategically important add-on unless adoption disappoints materially.
